name: korean-glass-skin-street
image_purpose: street-style beauty portrait and nostalgic social post

prompt.project_info: Hyper-photorealistic street-style portrait adapted from the source prompt and attached identity reference.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult woman matching the supplied approved-adult identity reference, with visible pores, rosy dewy complexion, straight medium hair with wind-swept face-framing strands, Korean glass-skin makeup and confident slightly aloof gaze, wearing a beige varsity jacket with embroidered patches over a black inner top.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct on-camera flash with harsh falloff, flattened shadows, mildly washed cool-neutral colors, visible digital noise and early-2000s compact-camera mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical portrait, old CCD digital-camera look, slight motion blur, crisp flash-lit subject, realistic skin and fabric, imperfect candid framing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-photorealistic vertical old-CCD digital-camera portrait of a clearly adult woman matching the supplied approved-adult identity reference, visible pores and rosy dewy skin, medium straight wind-swept hair, Korean glass-skin makeup and confident aloof gaze, beige embroidered varsity jacket over black inner top, three-quarter diagonal pose with one shoulder dropped, clean minimal urban backdrop, direct flash, harsh falloff, digital grain and washed early-2000s snapshot colors, no text or logos.
